Phase 4 of the slice-fleet cutover (`blueprint/slice-fleet-cutover/phase-4-cutover-tooling.md`): the one-time gen-1 -> gen-2 cutover tooling. Stacked on `new-fleet-phase-4`.

- New `minds-admin cutover {preflight, drain, repave, restore}` for the activated env (runbook: `apps/minds/docs/deploy/gen2-cutover.md`). `preflight` is read-only: it classifies every gen-1 pool row (candidate / destroy / refused with a remedy; the whole-tier run also lists the gen-1 rows on no box, such as finalized stops, as refusals), probes each workspace's served VM host key, `git describe` version against the `minds-v0.3.10` floor, health and gen-1 data disk, and checks each box's post-repave fit against both budgets. `drain` harvests the VM and container SSH keys plus `docker inspect`, halts the lima VM (refusing to upload unless the box reports the VM halted), uploads the encrypted gen-1 data disk with a manifest to `s3://<bucket>/<prefix>cutover/<host_id>/`, parks the row, destroys unleased rows and sets the box `draining`. `repave` flips a drained box to gen-2 and reinstalls + preps it to `ready`, recording its measured storage partition. `restore` transplants the home subvolume onto a fresh gen-2 data disk (`btrfs send | receive`), reserves the slice at the workspace's old ports with the harvested VM keys, boots it, loads the version's image tar, recreates the container from the harvested inspect, replays its keys, the `/home/user` -> host-volume home symlink mngr's container setup normally creates (read, like the autostart installer, from the version's `.mngr/settings.toml`) and the autostart installer, polls the health probe for up to 10 min and only then re-leases the row; it then bakes pool rows from `--pool-tag`. Every stage resumes from `~/.minds-<env>/cutover/`, mutating stages take `--dry-run` and require `--yes-i-mean-<tier>`; a box named with `--server-id` that is outside the stage's scope is refused rather than skipped. The restore's disk transplant works under `/srv/mngr-slices/cutover/<instance>` on the box's storage partition. Deleted in phase 6.

- New `minds-admin workspaces start <host_db_id>`: starts a stopped workspace through the connector's admin endpoint (no owner quota check), the pre-window remedy for stopped gen-1 rows.

- `server prep` on a gen-2 box installs `btrfs-progs`, loads `nbd` (`max_part=16`) at boot, creates the image tar cache at `/srv/mngr-slices/image-cache`, puts the 32 GiB swapfile on the storage partition, and reports the measured storage partition size (`MNGR_STORAGE_PARTITION_GIB`), which `server prep` / `server setup` record as the box's `disk_gb`. The gen-2 disk budget is that measured partition minus a 64 GiB reserve (swapfile, image cache, base image, staging margin) instead of the previous estimate from the delivered disk size.

- `server setup`'s body is reusable as `setup_server_to_ready(...)` (the cutover's repave calls it).
